from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,os,hashlib
root=Path('/tmp/atcoder_trie_gcc_20261019/validation');source=root/'bulk.cpp'
report={'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'tests_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'chunks.cpp').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'results':[],'conditions':'External public-API model, exact full-prefix capacity count via sorted adjacent bit widths; capacities 4095/4096/4097/8191/8192/8193/100000. Dense prefix reaches end of block, deletion frees a leaf, then far branch consumes free list, unused tail, next block. Budget -1..5 tests every allocation point, unique/add, anonymous/ID; repeated retry and fill checks complete reclamation.'}
for compiler,extra in [('g++',[]),('clang++',['--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'])]:
 for skip in [False,True]:
  for sanitized in ([False,True] if compiler=='clang++' else [False]):
   exe=root/f'chunks-{compiler}-{skip}-{sanitized}';cmd=[compiler,*extra,'-std=c++23','-O1' if sanitized else '-O2','-DTRIE_SOURCE="'+str(source)+'"']
   if skip:cmd+=['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']
   if sanitized:cmd+=['-g','-fsanitize=address,undefined','-fno-omit-frame-pointer']
   cmd+=[str(root/'chunks.cpp'),'-o',str(exe)]
   subprocess.run(cmd,check=True,capture_output=True)
   p=subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,env={**os.environ,'ASAN_OPTIONS':'detect_leaks=0'})
   r={'compiler':compiler,'skip':skip,'sanitized':sanitized,'counts':json.loads(p.stdout)};report['results'].append(r);print(r,flush=True)
(root/'bulk-chunks-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
